text.Defense Center:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, gain either 2 Combat or 3 Authority (but not both). Also when played with another Trade Federation card the ally ability triggers adding another 2 combat. As an Outpost the Defense Center protects your bases and your HQ for a decent 5 points.
 Strategy ==
Probably one of the better cards within the Trade Federation Faction the Defense Center gives protection and flexibility by offering the choice between Authority and Combat. And when the Ally ability triggers it can even give you both. This can be quite a menace if you can frequently put it or if it stays into play.
